rationale.consistency: Follows cmd/ layout and flag names of zoekt-git-index, but pulls in golang.org/x/sys/unix without build tags, uses a 2026 Sourcegraph header unlike siblings, and shadows the `path` import in resolveRoots.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles .git files, bare repos, duplicate names/sources, missing index dir, EINTR on flock; but no-root case returns an error without printing usage, and compound shards make list/sync hard-fail instead of being skipped.
rationale.scope: Delivers discovery, dry-run/-f sync, list, remove, lock; adds unrequested `sync` alias and source-path selectors for remove, and a DryRun option on gitindex.Options that is broader than strictly needed.
rationale.readability: Clear small functions, tabwriter list output, explanatory comments on the defer and removal order; minor variable shadowing (path) in a few places.
rationale.robustness: Lock scoped to -f only, errors joined and reported; but the gitindex defer-restore of desc.Name changes name precedence for any caller that pre-sets Name (zoekt-git-index does), risking altered shard names for existing users despite the 'keep caller behaviour' constraint.
rationale.maintainability: Plan/apply split and shared applyRemovals are tidy; the hidden defer-based override in setTemplatesFromRepo is implicit coupling that a future maintainer could easily break, versus an explicit opt-in option.
